title: World War II: European Theater
text: In Europe, World War II was fought primarily between the Axis powers (Germany, Italy) and the Allied powers (UK, France, Soviet Union, USA). Germany's rapid conquest of Western Europe in 1940 (Fall of France) left Britain standing alone. The Battle of Britain (1940) saw the Luftwaffe fail to achieve air superiority over the RAF. Germany invaded the Soviet Union in June 1941 in Operation Barbarossa. The turning points included the Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943) and the Allied invasion of Normandy (D-Day) on June 6, 1944. Germany surrendered on May 8, 1945, known as V-E Day. The European theater saw some of the war's most devastating battles.
